notificationChannel: Inject the exact owner-approved channel from private deployment evidence; no recipient address or credential stored here.

policies.displayName: ISP / backup and signature Job failure

documentation.content: A non-success terminal result was reported for the ISP backup or signature updater. Inspect the exact Job execution. Do not force a retry or bypass cooldown. This alert does not prove that a daily private Drive COMPLETE manifest exists or signatures remain fresh.

conditions.displayName: Non-success isp-drive-backup execution reported within five minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.project_id = "isp-planter-app" AND resource.labels.location = "asia-southeast1" AND resource.labels.job_name = "isp-drive-backup" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result != "succeeded"

conditions.displayName: Non-success isp-clamav-updater execution reported within five minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.project_id = "isp-planter-app" AND resource.labels.location = "asia-southeast1" AND resource.labels.job_name = "isp-clamav-updater" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/completed_execution_count" AND metric.labels.result != "succeeded"

policies.displayName: ISP / backup or signature Job running too long

documentation.content: The aggregate running count remains positive beyond the expected window. Inspect the exact executions before acting; queued, startup or overlapping work can affect this signal. No automatic cancellation or retry is configured. Missing dispatch, backup COMPLETE status and signed-definition freshness remain manual checks.

conditions.displayName: Backup running count positive for 35 minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.project_id = "isp-planter-app" AND resource.labels.location = "asia-southeast1" AND resource.labels.job_name = "isp-drive-backup" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/running_executions"

conditions.displayName: Signature updater running count positive for 25 minutes

conditionThreshold.filter: resource.type = "cloud_run_job" AND resource.labels.project_id = "isp-planter-app" AND resource.labels.location = "asia-southeast1" AND resource.labels.job_name = "isp-clamav-updater" AND metric.type = "run.googleapis.com/job/running_executions"
